tool_mode: Codex built-in image_gen; one call per distinct board
intent: Generate morphology-first character-development sheets before face, material, color, or cinematic rendering decisions.
common_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Starlight Intelligence robot morphology exploration sheet, pre-production silhouette gate. Create four genuinely different original robot character silhouettes for the named form family. Each candidate must have a different body architecture and locomotion or support idea while belonging to one coherent Starlight universe. Present four separate full-body candidates on a clean warm-white industrial-design sheet, arranged left to right with generous separation, consistent scale, and no cropping. Use premium feature-animation and AAA game character-development principles without imitating any franchise: immediate thumbnail silhouette, role-led function, one dominant shape, one supporting shape, one surprising functional detail. Render flat black and charcoal cut-paper silhouettes with only subtle mid-gray overlap planes. Preserve a softened rounded-square Starlight motif somewhere in each form. No eyes, face, mouth, text, labels, numbers, logos, weapons, capes, halos, decorative circuitry, glow, background scene, copied character silhouette, generic sci-fi armor, superhero stance, or ornamental AI nodes.
quality_gates: role readable at 96 pixels without color
no face or eye design yet
no decorative rendering used to hide weak form
founder selection before turnaround or polish

boards.prompt_delta: Full specialist, 6.5 to 7 heads tall, adult machine proportions. Explore a civic instrument, lantern scholar, folded architectural shell, and asymmetric analytical chassis. Calm neutral stance, restrained hands, visible but understated role utility. Avoid fashion-model anatomy, military armor, and heroic power poses.
boards.inspection: Strong structural range and construction quality. Iterate because the lantern is too literal and two bodies drift toward fashion-model proportions.

boards.prompt_delta: Compact field specialist, 4 to 4.75 heads tall, short stable legs, broad expressive feet, compact torso with a functional tool bay, useful articulated hands. Explore rounded trapezoid torso, low cylindrical torso, folded ceramic shell, and modular pack-and-tool chassis. Capable adult machines, never children or toys.
boards.inspection: Pass for meaningful chassis diversity; iterate because internal component detail exceeds the silhouette-only constraint.

boards.prompt_delta: Chibi Academy guide, 2.6 to 3.2 heads tall, very short legs, large rounded-square head volume, oversized functional hands, simple stable feet, and reduced seams. Explore book-carrying tutor, workshop guide, observatory guide, and values steward. Warm through proportion and gesture, not smiles. Avoid baby onesies, plush-toy anatomy, and resemblance to Astro Bot, WALL-E, or Baymax.
boards.inspection: Pass for four materially different Academy roles and a clear increase in construction quality. Iterate because the observatory guide exceeds the requested chibi ratio and circular sensor apertures dominate three candidates.

boards.prompt_delta: Micro-avatar family for 32 to 96 pixel UI use. Create four head, bust, or emblem architectures built from only two or three dominant shapes: soft-square aperture, lantern housing, folded plane, and screenless witness form. Treat each as a physical icon silhouette, not a logo sheet. No full bodies and no tiny interior detail.
boards.inspection: Strong pass: four distinct low-detail contours with explicit thumbnail proof. Best current family for graph nodes, dense lists, and runtime UI.

boards.prompt_delta: Guardian operator with broad low center of gravity, protective torso, small calm sensor head, planted stance, and visible shielding, audit, or containment function. Explore seated sentinel, arch-backed custodian, low quadruped guardian, and compact bipedal steward. Protective rather than intimidating. No weapons, riot-police language, spikes, or angry eye geometry.
boards.inspection: Strong pass for calm protection, visibly different support systems, and non-militarized posture. Candidate two best expresses inspectable evidence storage.

boards.prompt_delta: Agile research and discovery scout. Explore light asymmetric biped, compact digitigrade courier, three-point rolling walker, and folding directional sensor chassis. Long spring geometry or visibly purposeful mobility, minimal cargo, and clear orientation toward a task. Avoid predatory insects, combat drones, random antenna forests, and speed-line clichés.
boards.inspection: Pass for locomotion diversity and task orientation. Iterate because camera-like optics dominate the family and several forms resemble familiar inspection robots.

boards.prompt_delta: Clean biotech symbiote inspired by soft robotics and plant, manta, coral, and cephalopod engineering principles. Explore flexible standing membrane, low manta-like lab companion, branching photosensitive synthesist, and modular coral-like walker. Dry engineered surfaces, graceful load paths, distributed sensing. Avoid flesh, organs, veins, human anatomy, parasites, wet horror, and medical-device mimicry.
boards.inspection: Strong pass for genuinely non-humanoid range, credible support logic, dry biotech materials, and distinctive silhouettes. Candidate three is tree-like and should be tested against generic biomimetic sculpture risk.

boards.prompt_delta: Swarm gestalt made from five to twelve small functional units. Explore docking tiles forming a temporary helper, relay walkers forming a bridge, seed-like research units creating a collective frame, and carrying units assembling a mobile archive. Each formation must have readable individual units and a clear collective task. Avoid particle clouds, orbital-node diagrams, anonymous dots, magical mist, and a single ungoverned hive-mind impression.
boards.inspection: Restart required: candidates lack sufficient unit and formation diversity, and the third composition reintroduces the prohibited central-node trope. Preserve only as negative evidence.

boards.prompt_delta: Non-humanoid role instrument. Explore an archive lantern on a mobile base, a folding verification press, a walking map table, and a compact mobile lens-and-sample laboratory. Function should create character without a face. Avoid generic glowing orbs, random control panels, fake text, and concealed humanoid bodies.
boards.inspection: Strong pass for function-led non-humanoid character and useful turnaround cues. Generated paper markings are illustrative noise and cannot be used as public text.

boards.prompt_delta: Original creature companion robots derived from function rather than literal animals. Explore a low quadruped field helper, a book-carrying bird-like guide, a seedling-legged reminder companion, and an aquatic-inspired hovering scout. Mechanical and ownable, with clear carrying or sensing utility. Avoid recognizable pet-robot products, Star Wars droids, cartoon animal faces, or franchise silhouettes.
boards.inspection: Pass for four functional companion roles and silhouettes. Iterate because the reminder note contains fake generated text and the hovering scout needs clearer lift logic.

boards.prompt_delta: Soft-shell care collaborator using textile, inflated lattice, silicone bumper, and compliant robotics principles. Explore seated listening form, mobile supportive workstation, soft-armed carrying assistant, and cocoon-like recovery guide. Safe contact and calm presence without pretending to be human. Avoid Baymax resemblance, inflatable mascot shapes, hospital branding, or sentimental smiles.
boards.inspection: Good soft-material and safe-contact exploration. Iterate because three candidates read as care furniture or medical mobility products more than autonomous collaborators.

boards.prompt_delta: Modular transforming fabricator whose body reconfigures visibly around real tasks. Explore folding bench-to-biped, tool-cart-to-helper, stacked modules forming a tall reach mode, and compact carrier unfolding into a fabrication frame. Show plausible joints and mass distribution in a single neutral configuration per candidate. Avoid magical shape-shifting, Transformers resemblance, weapons, and impossible floating parts.
boards.inspection: Pass for repairable module logic and readable alternate-mode insets. The first candidate is the clearest transformation; the others need a second mechanics pass.

boards.prompt_delta: Aerial knowledge navigator for mapping, retrieval, and observatory work. Explore quiet ducted-lift ring, manta-wing glider, suspended archive spindle, and folding fan-like surveyor. Give every form credible lift or suspension logic and a calm non-military silhouette. Avoid quadcopter cliché, combat drone language, angel wings, halos, and impossible levitation without visible support logic.
boards.inspection: Pass for four distinct aerial architectures. Iterate because candidate three uses a familiar twin-duct drone arrangement despite the explicit anti-cliché constraint.

boards.prompt_delta: Room-scale or architectural intelligence embodied as an environment rather than a person. Explore a mobile collaborative alcove, an archive doorway, a circular learning table that reorients to participants, and a modular wall-and-seat research station. Each must read as one agent with boundaries and human-accessible interaction points. Avoid generic sci-fi rooms, command centers, screens everywhere, temples, thrones, and surveillance architecture.
boards.inspection: Strong pass for bounded spatial agency, human scale, and transformation diagrams. Best current proof that an agent need not be a body or face.
